scan_id.description: start, step: the scan this result is about. A remove names its scans in removed

status.description: start, step: running, done, file_cap_reached (max_files judged), examined_cap_reached (max_files_examined seen), judge_unavailable, request_blocked, storage_cap, or legacy_report_only (a scan this version reports and does not step). remove: removed

max_files.description: the most files the scan judges

max_files_examined.description: the most files the scan examines, judged or skipped

files_pending_known.description: files listed and not yet examined, while the scan is unfinished

dirs_unlisted.description: folders not yet listed, while the scan is unfinished

calls_per_judged_file.description: once a file is judged: judge calls per judged file, and the same with cache hits counted

judge_calls.description: at a start: the judge calls a judged file costs before caching

progress.description: that the scan is unfinished and who steps it

sent_to.description: where this step's texts were sent: the judge's backend and address

expired_removed.description: start: the scans removed because they had expired, each with when it expired

recognised_languages.description: start: the languages a file must be in to be judged

rules_without_calls.description: start: for each recognised language, the slop rules applied from the file's text with no judge call

scope.description: start: what a file must be to be judged; anything else is listed out of scope with its reason

intent_calls.description: of calls, those that asked the intent question

removed.description: remove: the scans removed, by id
